svg.text: McCzarny recently updated the ghsummary action
in his McCzarny repository to use the master
branch. In the ghsummary project, he updated
LLM models to gemini-3.6-flash and
gemini-3.5-flash-lite, and added basic
Markdown formatting support for SVG summaries.
For chromium-daily-digest, he also updated
Gemini models and implemented dynamic favicon
and logo changes to indicate new versions. He
further enhanced the daily digest tool to
support relative day numbers and added a
version check. In his flexible-log-analyzer
project, he introduced a GitHub Actions
workflow for publishing to the Open VSX
Registry, updated dependencies, and bumped the
extension's version to 0.3.11. He also
addressed CodeQL findings by adjusting workflow
permissions and disabled VSX publishing on the
development branch.
